in_sanskrit.name: सुब्रत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Subrata is derived from the Sanskrit words 'subh' which means auspicious, good, excellent, and 'rata' which means friend or companion. It is a name that signifies the presence of good fortune and positivity in one's life, as well as a strong bond of friendship.
